title: Stress-Energy Tensor of a Scalar Field on a Product Spacetime with a Time-Dependent Compact Dimension
summary: We compute the vacuum expectation value of the stress-energy tensor of a scalar field on a product spacetime composed of an FLRW background times a compact dimension ($\mathcal{M}^{1, \,d-1} \times \mathcal{S}^1$), where the size of the latter is allowed to vary with time. We modify the standard adiabatic regularization prescription to obtain analytic expressions for both $d=3$ and $d=4$. In the massless and conformally coupled limit, the leading order time-dependent results are consistent with known time-independent Casimir contributions.
